translation: If I tell this to people, who can believe it? It is truly a good method for removing accumulation; why is it not recorded in the various books? Is it perhaps because removing accumulation too quickly and too completely harms people? I have tried it on my body, and it has benefit and no harm. Only the formula books treat wind impediment with the white-flowered snake (白花蛇); perhaps they took its shape? Although not stated clearly, the ancients can be called wise. Yet the medicine is taken into the stomach, and one wants the medicinal nature to move quickly within the skin and membranes to disperse the dead accumulation that is stuck and unmoving; one can imagine the difficulty, and it only wastes the upright qi.
